notFound.title: Page not found
screen.D1.title: Login
screen.D1.about: Phone + OTP (test code 123456), then PIN; session locks itself on shared PCs
screen.D2.title: Choose ward
screen.D2.about: For managers covering more than one ward
screen.D3.title: Overview
screen.D3.about: Stat tiles (free beds, open alerts, doses on time %) · bed map by status · live alert feed · staff on duty
screen.D4.title: Camera wall
screen.D4.about: Grid of feeds (2×1, 2×2, 3×3), AI boxes and bed IDs, faces blurred, event markers
screen.D5.title: Single camera
screen.D5.about: One feed large, with its event list (falls, nurse visits) and snapshots
screen.D6.title: Bed board
screen.D6.about: Every bed: status, time in status; filter by status; Mark ready
screen.D7.title: Bed detail
screen.D7.about: Current patient, history, cleaning log, mapped camera
screen.D8.title: Waiting queue
screen.D8.about: Ranked table with urgency request flag · “Why here?” score breakdown · Override with a reason
screen.D9.title: Add to queue
screen.D9.about: Scan Health Profile QR or enter details · priority · source · bed type
screen.D10.title: Urgency requests
screen.D10.about: Patient’s reason · Raise priority or Decline (reason required, patient sees the answer)
screen.D11.title: Assign bed
screen.D11.about: Freed bed matched to the top patient · Confirm or pick another (with a reason) · patient and desk notified
screen.D12.title: Staff on duty
screen.D12.about: Who is in, assigned beds, open tasks, overdue doses per nurse
screen.D13.title: Assign beds to nurses
screen.D13.about: Nurse columns; drag patient cards between them; ratio warning if over limit; Save
screen.D14.title: Shift planner
screen.D14.about: Week grid · AI-proposed plan · rule warnings · drag to change · Publish (with confirm)
screen.D15.title: Swap requests
screen.D15.about: Approve or Decline nurse swaps (decline needs a reason)
screen.D16.title: Incident log
screen.D16.about: Falls and missed doses: time, bed, response time, outcome
screen.D17.title: Incident detail
screen.D17.about: Alarm timeline (sent → escalated → acknowledged → resolved), outcome, notes
screen.D18.title: Dose compliance
screen.D18.about: On-time, late and missed doses by nurse, drug and time of day (bar charts + table)
screen.D19.title: Reports
screen.D19.about: Pilot metrics: bed turnover, doses on time, fall response time · before vs after · Export CSV / PDF
screen.D20.title: Patient directory
screen.D20.about: Search all ward patients → read-only profile (header + allergy strip + summary)
screen.D21.title: Approvals
screen.D21.about: Medicine approvals; only if the manager is also the senior nurse (same as Ward app W34)
